create_DiffusionModel: create a DiffusionModel instance by passing kwargs to GaussianDiffusion for motion diffusion training
run_masked_l2: run masked_l2 to compute the mean L2 norm loss between two tensors reshaped to 6D vectors
run_training_losses: run training_losses to compute MSE or KL loss terms for a diffusion model given x_start and timestep t
review_DiffusionModel_training_losses: review the DiffusionModel training_losses method to understand how it handles MSE, KL, and rescaled loss types
